accept_criteria: Gap evaluations cover manifest segments or documented exclusion rationale
Each evaluation cites segment_id and framing gap type with transcript evidence
Evaluations distinguish missing context, weak follow-up, and unanswered questions
Shard batches reach full segment coverage when max_gap_evaluations cap hit
reject_patterns: Partial gap coverage with truncation and no decompose
Evaluations that invent gaps without transcript support
Empty evaluations when manifest has interview segments
